decisions.reason: The Table of Content review is independently and fully represented by its same-message INTRODUCE Event; expanding chapter-heading review to other titles and subtitles does not modify that Requirement.
The request to review chapter titles and subtitles does not change the established italic and quotation-mark treatment for Mama's Hot Take sections.
The page-number request is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY Event and is independent of the chapter-heading scope expansion.
Reviewing chapter titles and subtitles does not resume or change the deferred body-text spacing requirement.
Chapter-heading and subtitle review does not change the justified alignment required for body text.
The heading-review request does not alter the paperback publication format or 6 x 9 inch trim size.
The source concerns textual chapter headings and subtitles, not image distortion, cropping, pixelation, or rendering quality.
The phrase concerning other chapters applies to their titles and subtitles and does not change chapter-image coverage, placement, or presentation.
The heading-review request does not change the source, permission, review requirement, or suitability criteria for chapter illustrations.
The source discusses chapter titles rather than the book title and does not alter the constraint excluding the unintended newline marker.
Reviewing chapter titles and subtitles does not affect the copyright page's centre alignment.
The question about the client's name on the first manuscript page does not resolve or modify the separate paperback-cover design requirement or its existing ambiguity.
